name: excel_view
description: Frappe Excel View — spreadsheet experience for any DocType

_packageNotes.handsontable: Spreadsheet grid engine (v6.2.2 pinned — free license boundary)
_packageNotes.hyperformula: Excel-compatible formula engine powering all ERP-native formulas
_packageNotes.@duckdb/duckdb-wasm: Client-side analytical SQL engine (WASM) for PivotBuilder and IntelliFlow V3 queries
_packageNotes.@observablehq/plot: Declarative chart library used by ChartManager for insert-chart feature
_packageNotes.uplot: High-performance time-series chart library for sparklines and trend charts
_packageNotes.@simonwep/pickr: Color picker used by Focus Cell, Conditional Formatting, and cell color features
_packageNotes.papaparse: CSV parser for bulk import and DuckDB CSV ingestion
_packageNotes.numfmt: Number/currency formatting matching Excel format strings exactly
_packageNotes.dagre: [V3 IntelliFlow] Directed graph auto-layout algorithm — arranges canvas nodes left-to-right DAG
_packageNotes.sql-formatter: [V3 IntelliFlow] SQL pretty-printer — formats generated DuckDB SQL in the SQL preview panel
_packageNotes.comlink: [V3 IntelliFlow] Web Worker RPC wrapper — reserved for future DuckDB Worker thread isolation (not yet used in production)
